enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Extend arm. Breathe in. Breathe out. Lie on back. Stretch legs. Breathe in. Breathe out.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and taking a hot morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off alarm. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rinse body. Apply cleanser to face. Rinse face. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, having tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Take out pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Make tea. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing the work bag for the office
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Place phone in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone for time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email program. Read emails. Type replies. Click send. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Make phone call. Dial number. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Print document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay cashier. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap utensils. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office, planning program events and meeting with community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open calendar. Schedule event. Make phone calls to partners. Send emails. Attend meeting in conference room. Take notes. Discuss plans with partners. Shake hands. Return to desk. Type report. Print report. File documents.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote on table. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone down. Lean back. Cross legs. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening hot shower after the peak-tax window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Adjust shower temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer and winding down with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Press power button. Enter password. Open document. Type. Click. Save. Close document. Open browser. Check email. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Change into pajamas. Lie in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and evening wash before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Breathe in. Breathe out. Lie on back. Stretch arms. Breathe in. Breathe out. Lie still.
